name: Premium Medium Breeds Adult Dry Dog Food

variants.name: Chicken 14 kg
variants.about_this_item: ADVANTAGES: 24/13 – a well-balanced formula for everyday feeding 100% quality animal protein Optimum pellet for medium-sized breed dogs A mixture of tocopherols as a natural antioxidant Vitamins D3, E, B1, B5, microelements and amino acids Omega 3 + Omega 6 for healthy skin and shiny coat INTEGRAMIX formula: dried tomatoes, ginger, hawthorn and bananas - for pet’s general health and strong immunity Without artificial flavors and colours
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: COMPOSITION: dehydrated chicken protein 28 %, rice, maize, barley, poultry fat (preserved with tocopherols), hydrolyzed animal protein, sugar beet pulp, minerals, linseed 0,52 %, salmon oil 0,5 %, brewery yeast, banana* 0,23 %, tomatoes* 0,2 %, hawthorn* 0,065 %, ginger* 0,01 %.

Analytical constituents: ANALYTICAL CONSTITUENTS: crude protein 24 %, crude fat 13 %, crude ash 6,3 %, crude fibre 2,2 %, calcium 1,3 %, phosphorus 1 %, omega-3 fatty acids 0,36 %, omega-6 fatty acids 2,79 %.

Additives: ADDITIVES (per 1 kg of product): Nutritional additives: vitamin A (3а672а): 12 000 IU, vitamin D3 (3а671): 960 IU, vitamin E (3а700): 320 mg, vitamin К3 (3а711): 5,2 mg, vitamin B1 (3а821): 2,39 mg, vitamin B2 (3a825i): 7,28 mg, vitamin B5 (calcium-D-pantothenate 3а841): 18,98 mg, niacin (3a314): 23,64 mg, vitamin B6 (3а831): 2,8 mg, folic acid (3а316): 0,42 mg, vitamin B12 (3a835): 0,167 mg, biotin (3а880): 0,095 mg, choline (choline chloride 3а890): 2,5 g; zinc (3b605): 184 mg, copper (3b405): 19,7 mg, selenium (3b801): 0,14 mg; antioxidants, preservatives. *Natural ingredients, dried. Metabolizable energy per 100 g of pet food: 1 564 kJ (374 kcal).
